Method of Attack: Encrypts files by appending specific extensions and demands ransom for decryption
Uses unique encryption keys per user
Files are encrypted and renamed with extensions such as .amnesia, .CRYPTOBOSS, .01, .02, .@decrypt_2017, .[byd@india.com].SON, .[Help244@Ya.RU].LOCKED
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with encrypted files renamed with Amnesia ransomware extensions
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note file named HOW TO RECOVER ENCRYPTED FILES.TXT
